title: Week 16 Mastery Quiz

questions.question: Which definition best matches “interest group”?
options: The amount by which government spending exceeds revenue during a period.
An extreme authoritarian system seeking pervasive control over political, social, economic, and private life.
A testable claim about what is, was, or is likely to occur.
An organization seeking to influence public policy without primarily nominating candidates.
questions.explanation: Interest group means an organization seeking to influence public policy without primarily nominating candidates.

questions.question: Which action best demonstrates mastery of the Week 16 inquiry?
options: A student accepts the first available claim or offer without checking the source, terms, evidence, or consequences.
A student follows a political claim to the underlying public record and separates fact, inference, persuasion, and opinion.
A student relies on political identity, advertising, or personal preference as a substitute for documented analysis.
A student selects an answer only because it sounds confident, even when the record is incomplete or contradictory.
questions.explanation: A student follows a political claim to the underlying public record and separates fact, inference, persuasion, and opinion.
